wafProbeResult: All 8 batches returned 200 with consistent ~160ms latency. Server header is DPS/2.0.0 (GoDaddy Digital Presence Server) on every request. No cf-ray, no x-sucuri, no Incapsula cookies, no MalCare/Wordfence body markers. Rapid burst (10 sequential GETs) all 200. Honeypot paths (/wp-admin, /.env, /.git/config, /xmlrpc.php) return 404 (not blocked). SQLi and XSS payloads return 200 same as default. No WAF.

apiAlternative.notes: Plain HTTP works at scale. Walked 8 pages x 250 = 1952 unique product ids, no rate-limit, no errors. q[descend_by_created_at]=true monotonically decreasing ids (3292,3291,3290). Default sort returns id-asc. Counter-control q[ascend_by_name]=true returns alphabetical first results — 3-outcome test confirms sort is honored, not NOOP. Date filters (created_at_gteq, created_at_gt, created_at_after) silently ignored (return full 1952). Category filters (category_slug_eq, category_id_eq, etc.) silently ignored. Therefore the API only supports flat-catalog sort+paginate; per-category catalog walks are NOT possible via the API. The product objects have categories:[] populated as empty arrays.

watermark.reason: Sort q[descend_by_created_at]=true verified honored via 3-outcome counter-control test (default=id-asc, sorted=id-desc 3292/3291/3290, counter=alpha-asc). Date filter (api-date-since-watermark Method A) is NOT honored — q[created_at_gteq], q[created_at_gt], q[created_at_after] all return full total_count=1952 regardless of value. Therefore Method A is impossible, Method B applies: walk newest-first by sort, stop at watermark.

topLevelCategories.totalsSumCheck: Site has 149 storefront category URLs (visible in /sitemap.ols.xml under /shop/ols/categories/<slug>) but the mysimplestore JSON API does not honor any category filter (category_slug_eq, categories_slug_eq, category_id_eq, category=, category_slug= all return the unfiltered total_count=1952). The API exposes a single flat catalog. catalogUrls collapsed to a single entry '/shop' because the API-driven runtime path covers 100% of products in one walk (8 pages x 250).

stageNotes: Stage 1 (canonical): apex https://liangjian.ca returns 200 directly. www redirects 301 to apex. Canonical = apex.
Stage 2 (WAF/CAPTCHA): heavy 8-batch probe shows DPS/2.0.0 server, no CDN markers, all paths/payloads return 200, no plugin-WAF body markers. hasWaf=false. No CAPTCHA script tags in homepage HTML.

Stage 3 (platform): GoDaddy OLS confirmed via img1.wsimg.com image CDN, /shop URL prefix, GoDaddy footer link, DPS server header. /shop static HTML has zero PRODUCT_LIST_RENDERED markers — SPA. adapterType=generic-retail (which already has the mysimplestore branch wired at generic-retail.ts:351 and the GoDaddy OLS Playwright selector at line 88/971). No age-gate.

Stage 4 (catalogUrls): mysimplestore API at https://31990017-c17c-4c86-89ca-5fc9b6a1bb06.mysimplestore.com/api/v2/products returns total_count=1952. Walked 8 pages x 250 = 1952 unique ids, full coverage in one walk. API does not honor category filters — flat catalog only. catalogUrls=['/shop'] is the operator-facing canonical URL; the runtime hits the mysimplestore origin via apiAlternative branch. Extraction spot-check on 3 products (positions 0, 500, 999) all yielded title+url+price+stockStatus — extractionTested=true.

Stage 5 (pagination): API ?page=N&per_page=N. Verified perPage ceiling = 1000 (per_page=2500 silently capped at 1000). Shipping perPage=250 to match existing apiAlternative.maxPerPage (250) and keep page-size in line with what was previously validated; bumping to 1000 is a follow-up optimization. paginationPattern.type=api-page since this is JSON API pagination, not HTML.

Stage 6 (sort): newest-first sort = q[descend_by_created_at]=true. 3-outcome counter-control test passed: default returns id-asc (1,3,4); sorted returns id-desc (3292,3291,3290 created 2026-05-11); counter (q[ascend_by_name]=true) returns alphabetical (74-style, A-Zoom...). sortVerified=true.

Stage 7 (watermark): Method A (api-date-since-watermark) attempted — Ransack date filters q[created_at_gteq], q[created_at_gt], q[created_at_after] all silently ignored (return full total). Method B (navigate-from-watermark) applies: sort verified honored upstream and each product carries created_at; walk newest-first stops at watermark.

Stage 8 (count): /sitemap.ols.xml has 2103 <loc> entries; filtering on /shop/ols/products/<slug>$ pattern yields 1952 entries — exact match to API total_count=1952. productCountMethod=generic-product-sitemap (the canonical name; older DB profiles label this 'sitemap-filtered'). Note the runtime json-api-count enum builds URL as origin+endpoint and cannot point to foreign-origin mysimplestore.com — so generic-product-sitemap is the working choice today.

Stage 9 (assembly): One catalogUrl, one canonical sort, no WAF, no CAPTCHA, no age-gate, navigate-from-watermark via sort+created_at. Production crawler already has the mysimplestore branch wired (generic-retail.ts:351) and the SPA HTML fallback selector (line 88,971); no new code required.
